# Digil David

> Senior Product Designer & AI Experience Lead based in Dubai, UAE. Leads product design at Würth UAE and builds full-stack, AI and agentic AI products independently.

Digil David has 8+ years of experience in UI/UX and product design. He currently leads product design at Würth UAE (since July 2020), where he redesigned B2B/B2C e-commerce checkout flows for an 18% conversion lift, built a Figma design system that improved dev handoff efficiency by 30%, and integrated AI workflows (prompt engineering, VEO3) that cut external creative video costs by 40%.

Beyond design, he is a full-stack developer working with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python and SQL, and builds AI, agentic AI and LLM/SLM-driven products, including WhatsApp commerce ordering systems, AI voice calling agents, and an Excel AI add-in.
